verdict.rationale: BugSnag's error-status docs show errors can be fixed, snoozed or ignored, and those triage actions are available through dashboard keyboard shortcuts. Its automatic-assignment rules route errors to a team or an individual collaborator. Nothing in the pack shows a resolved error reopening automatically when it regresses. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic reopen on regression, detailed first-party docs on manual assignment and on snooze conditions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can triage issues — assign an owner, resolve, ignore, or snooze — and the platform reopens a resolved issue automatically when it regresses

citations.quote: All errors except those that are fixed, snoozed or ignored
assigning all errors that originate from files in the src/components/cart directory to the “Cart Team” or an individual collaborator. BugSnag allows you to create rules to automate this process.
The actions above can also be completed via dashboard keyboard shortcuts.
